headline: Contested Fronts Register Fresh Base Shifts
war_summary: The latest returns show fresh changes across War 140’s unsettled fronts, with 34 victory towns still required. Nevish Line has moved from six Colonial, two Warden bases to four Colonial, three Warden and one neutral; two event rows fell in the latest two hours, with 29 in the day. Weathered Expanse now stands at three bases for each side and three neutral, compared with two apiece and five neutral in the last edition; its recent pace has eased to one event in two hours, though 53 were recorded in 24. Linn’s Mercy has shifted to seven Colonial, three Warden and one neutral, and registered three events in the latest two hours. Mooring County is now entirely Warden-held, twelve bases, after its previous eleven-to-one Warden tally; two event rows were logged in two hours. Stonecradle remains eight Colonial to one Warden, with eight events in six hours but none in the latest two. Marban Hollow’s four-to-three Warden-Colonial division and one neutral post are unchanged, with no events in six hours. The counts mark where ownership has moved—and where the record has lately fallen quiet.
